description: This file defines an abstract class 'Tasker' that manages dispatching tasks either asynchronously or synchronously, with fallback and error handling, within a TypeScript project.

classes.name: Tasker
classes.description: An abstract class that manages task dispatching with support for async and sync taskers, including fallback and error handling.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Public method to dispatch a task by name with arguments, with logging and safe dispatch logic.

methods.name: _safeDispatch
methods.description: Private method that attempts to dispatch a task, handles errors, and falls back to sync tasker if async fails.

methods.name: getErrorDetails
methods.description: Extracts and returns error details, redacting sensitive information.
